confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for Bali (Ubud/Canggu) in July 2026, not based on live listings or prices I checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Canggu café and bar prices run higher than Ubud, so the values sit between the two. Accommodation tiers are less certain because Bali's registered-versus-unregistered stock and villa-style guesthouses vary widely. Cocktail and wine values lean on the local beer price relationship, since direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker. Figures are typical ordinary-venue prices, not tourist-trap or luxury rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Indonesian and Southeast Asian tourist-hub pricing, in the range of Chiang Mai and Da Nang for food and budget lodging. Canggu cafés and bars are priced at a premium over that baseline, and cocktail and wine prices are set relative to beer.
